answer: Trust grows on a trellis, not bought off a shelf: every identity starts at rung zero and climbs one rung per epoch of honest work, never faster, each rung stamped on-chain like an onyx seal, impossible to backdate. Twelve rungs earn full rights; a newborn clone holds none, so 10,000 clones can only touch low-value work while honest agents climb. Each identity posts a 15 POA deposit, and one proven fake resets it to rung zero and burns the deposit. Faking at scale locks 150,000 POA and still buys zero history, because the trellis only grows forward, one epoch at a time, like yarrow spreading.
